newsitem.title: CANADA: BC Telecom to invest C$26 mln more.
newsitem.headline: BC Telecom to invest C$26 mln more.

text.p: BC Telecom Inc said Thursday it will invest an additional C$26 million for electronic information services.
It will introduce later this month an integrated services digital network and is going to test in November asymmetric digital subscriber line technology.

The first program, called ISDN Home, will allow customers to use the Internet and download data and graphics five times faster than a 28.8 kilobit per second modem. It will provide two independent channels and will cost C$55 a month per line.

Under the initiative, a three-month market test will involve about 150 users and connect corporate local-area networks an the Internet at 1.5 megabits per second. The company expects to offer the service on a wider basis in mid-1997.
